All contractors must comply _____ the revised safety regulations.
The verb comply is followed by with: comply with a rule or requirement.
The manufacturer specializes _____ energy-efficient office equipment.
Use specialize in to identify a field or product area.
The board has not yet agreed _____ the proposed changes to the contract.
Use agree on for reaching a decision about a plan or issue.
Several employees objected _____ the proposed change in working hours.
The delay resulted _____ an unexpected inspection at the port.
Use result from to identify the cause of something.
The unexpected inspection resulted _____ a two-day delay in delivery.
Use result in to identify an outcome or consequence.
The consultant will deal _____ all questions concerning the new software.
Use deal with to mean handle or address an issue.
The company hopes to benefit _____ the tax incentives offered to new exporters.
Use benefit from to identify an advantage received.
The manager insisted _____ reviewing the figures before approving the budget.
Use insist on + noun or gerund (-ing form).
The new policy aims to prevent employees _____ sharing customer data externally.
The accounting team is responsible _____ processing approved reimbursements.
Use responsible for to identify a duty or assigned task.
The revised estimate is consistent _____ the figures submitted last month.
Use consistent with when information agrees or matches.
The new application is compatible _____ most current operating systems.
Use compatible with to show that two systems can work together.
The company is committed _____ reducing unnecessary packaging.
In committed to, to is a preposition, so it takes a noun or gerund.
The regional office is familiar _____ the updated customs procedures.
Use familiar with to describe knowledge of a subject or process.
The final price is subject _____ approval by the purchasing director.
The fixed expression is subject to approval or change.
The sales forecast is dependent _____ seasonal demand and exchange rates.
Use dependent on to identify what something relies on.
The new filing system is similar _____ the one used at headquarters.
The department received a request _____ additional technical support.
Use request for before the thing being requested.
The manager expressed confidence _____ the team’s ability to meet the deadline.
Use confidence in to identify the person or thing trusted.
The company reached an agreement _____ the local distributor.
Use agreement with to identify the other party.
The new software provides access _____ real-time inventory information.
There has been a steady increase _____ demand for electric delivery vehicles.
Use increase in to identify what has grown.
Please submit your travel request at least five days _____ advance.
The fixed expression is in advance, meaning ahead of time.
All revised proposals must reach the procurement office _____ 4:00 p.m. on Thursday.
Use by to indicate a deadline no later than a particular time.
The invoice must be paid _____ 30 days of its issue date.
Use within to mean before a time limit has passed.
The company will review all applications received _____ the next two weeks.
Use during before a noun phrase naming a period.
_____ the revised schedule, the maintenance work will begin on Saturday.
The phrase according to introduces the source of information.
The director signed the letter _____ behalf of the entire executive team.
The fixed expression is on behalf of.
The meeting was postponed _____ a technical problem with the video-conferencing system.
Use due to before a noun phrase to give the reason for something.
All visitors must check in at reception _____ entering the restricted area.
Prior to means before and is followed by a noun or gerund.
The company offered free installation _____ no additional cost.
The fixed phrase is at no additional cost.
The shipment is expected to arrive _____ schedule, despite the severe weather.
Use on schedule to mean at the planned time.
The quality-control team is _____ charge of inspecting every outgoing order.
The fixed expression is in charge of.
The new procedures were introduced _____ response to feedback from customers.
The fixed expression is in response to.
The agreement was signed _____ accordance with the company’s procurement policy.
The fixed expression is in accordance with.
The safety inspection will take place _____ the presence of a certified engineer.
The standard expression is in the presence of.
_____ the delay, the customer agreed to accept the replacement shipment.
Despite is a preposition followed by a noun phrase; it expresses contrast.
Please contact the help desk _____ connection with your access request.
The fixed expression is in connection with, meaning concerning or related to.
The revised contract will remain valid _____ the end of the calendar year.
Use until to mark the point when a period or situation ends.
